## Functions!

Start small with Z scores
```{r}
x_vec = rnorm(n = 40, mean = 12, sd = 63)

(x_vec - mean(x_vec)) / sd(x_vec)
```

Let's turn this into a function
```{r}
z_scores = function(x) {
  
  if(!is.numeric(x)){
    stop("Input x must be numeric")
  } else if (length(x) < 5) {
    stop("x should have 5 or more numbers")
  }
  
 z = (x - mean(x)) / sd(x)
 
 return(z)
  
}

#in the function it will take x and do those to it
```

Does this actually work???
```{r}
z_scores(x_vec)
z_scores(rpois(4000, lambda = 12))

# z_scores("my name is jeff") wont work
# z_scores(iris) also wont work
# z_scores(c(TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, FALSE)) wont work now that i added that input must be numeric in the function
# z_scores(3) wont work bc not enough numbers to calculate z-score
```
